title: A machine learning model to predict optimal antibiotic use in hospital medicine patients.
summary: A supervised model predicts expert-reviewed antibiotic-order appropriateness from patient records; 425 orders were annotated, and indicated vs optimal criteria achieved AUROCs 0.89 and 0.80.
ai_technology: Expert order review is the reference, but single-center point-prevalence sampling and order-level rather than patient-outcome validation bound the result.
organization: Department of Medicine; Division of Infectious Diseases
